description: Add an adjustment layer above the active layer (Layer > New Adjustment Layer, or the Adjustments panel), with its settings, optionally clipped to the layer below. Adjustment layers change the look of the layers beneath without changing their pixels. Options by type: brightness_contrast (brightness, contrast, useLegacy); levels (channel, inputBlack, inputWhite, gamma, outputBlack, outputWhite, auto); curves (channel, points); exposure (exposure, offset, gamma); vibrance (vibrance, saturation); color_and_vibrance (temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation); hue_saturation (hue, saturation, lightness, colorize, ranges); color_balance (shadows, midtones, highlights, preserveLuminosity); black_and_white (reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, tint, tintColor); photo_filter (filter, color, density, preserveLuminosity); channel_mixer (monochrome, red, green, blue, gray); selective_color (method, reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks); gradient_map (gradient, reverse, dither, method); posterize (levels); threshold (level); invert; color_lookup; clarity_and_dehaze (clarity, dehaze); grain (amount, size, roughness). Color Lookup is created with Photoshop's defaults; choose its LUT in the Properties panel. color_and_vibrance is the Color and Vibrance layer (Temperature, Tint, Vibrance, Saturation); its settings, and those of clarity_and_dehaze and grain, are Photoshop's own unless given.

above.description: Add it above this layer (the first match) instead of the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

clip.description: Use Previous Layer to Create Clipping Mask: affect only the layer below

options.description: Settings for the chosen type; see the list in this tool's description. Omitted settings use Photoshop's defaults
